name: Tsielekjåhkå-Piteälven
description: Tsielekjåkkstugan / Tsielekjåhkå to Piteälven / Västerfjäll stage break. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: STF/Naturkartan official section distance is 19 km, while WFS, Naturkartan GPX, OSM, Wikiloc and AllTrails-derived distances are around 20.3-21.7 km depending endpoint and split.
WFS/Naturkartan BD77 endpoint is around 66.718545,17.349377 / 66.7187905,17.3489166, while OSM relation 18864492 ends about 429 m southwest at 66.7163830,17.3412810 and section 15 starts there.
STF and Naturkartan user-facing stage says Piteälven; WFS state trail uses Västerfjäll; Piteälven Natura plan references the Tjieggelvas/Västerfjäll crossing context.
Tsielekjåhkå is used for stage/river-area label; Tsielekjåkkstugan / Stopover cabin Tsielekjåkk is the hut. Naturkartan says STF-run while STF route text treats it separately/non-STF.

Länsstyrelsen says Kungsleden passes through Pärlälvens fjällurskog generally, but section-14 route point sampling did not hit Pärlälvens or any Naturreservat layer. Piteälven Natura hits only at endpoint/final water area.
OSM has ferry/boat-storage-like tagging near Piteälven, but official stage descriptions and field reports indicate suspension bridge crossing, not a required ferry.
Weather, snow/ice, water levels, bridge condition, fire bans, hunting closures, reindeer restrictions and field infrastructure can change quickly.

facilities.name: Tsielekjåkkstugan / Tsielejåkkastuga
facilities.description: Unstaffed rest/emergency hut at section start. Naturkartan says open year-round with stove, latrine/toilet and emergency telephone; STF route text says unstaffed with limited beds. Model as unstaffed emergency/rest hut, not staffed STF cabin or dependable planned accommodation.
facilities.routeProximity: start endpoint POI; route line passes about 39-42 m away
